x: Our British and Southern League teams will be considerably strengthened after the end of May when Derek Brown and Tony Parmah become eligible to compete for us in open competition.
Andrew Rodney, Dave Armstrong, Phillip Goedluck, Tony Pamah, Derek Brown and Snowy Brooks (15 years since his debut in the British League) all made their first appearance.

Ian Bland and Derek Capper made their BAL debuts and it was good to see Alistair Johnson, Greggy, Vince and Derek Brown back in the team. At the end of the day we were a clear fourth in the league having finished just 17 points behind Haringey.
Derek Brown was injured much of the season but went over 15 metres for a fine Triple Jump 4th place in the Inter Counties Championships and placed 6th in the 'Southern'.
